items.text: Following a backlink or block reference to a highlight of a PDF that was not open yet now scrolls to that highlight, as Logseq does, instead of opening the PDF with the highlight marked but off-screen. The scroll waits for the page to finish drawing, happens once, and is dropped if you scroll yourself first (card hCAoxs).

items.text: Editing a Markdown block that has its own properties keeps the hidden `id::` and `collapsed::` lines in the same property group, as Logseq writes them. Before, they moved below the body text, where Logseq ignores them, so references to the block could break in Logseq (internal: REG-HIDDEN-PROPS-STAY-IN-THE-GROUP).
